betaTestNotes.en-US:
0.14.1: Find an actor’s work in local libraries and fix a crash when deleting conversations.

In a local or NFO library, open an item and tap an actor without an online person page. Check that the same library opens with Actor: Name applied; remove the actor condition or clear filters to return to all titles. Actor filtering requires MovieClaw Server 0.48.0 or later. Actors with an online person page still open that page; directors without one remain static.

On iPhone, open Me; on iPad, open your account name in the sidebar. Test cancelling and confirming a swipe deletion, long-press deletion, deletion from the conversation menu, and deleting the last conversation in a date group. The app should remain running.

Minimum server version remains 0.28.0, as in 0.13.0.
betaTestNotes.zh-Hans:
0.14.1：从本地演员找到同库作品，并修复删除会话闪退。

在本地库或 NFO 库的条目详情中，点没有在线影人页的演员，检查是否打开同一媒体库的「演员：姓名」作品墙；移除演员条件或清空筛选后应回到整库。演员筛选需要 MovieClaw 服务器 0.48.0 或更新版本。带在线影人页的演员仍打开影人页，没有影人页的导演不可点。

iPhone 从「我的」进入会话列表；iPad 从侧边栏账号名进入个人空间。请检查左滑删除时取消与确认、长按删除、会话页菜单删除，以及删除某个日期分组最后一条时 App 保持正常运行。

最低服务器要求与 0.13.0 相同：0.28.0。

betaTestNotes.en-US:
0.14.1: Follow a local actor into the library.

In a local or NFO library, open an item and select an actor without an online person page. Check that the same library opens with Actor: Name below its title. Remove the condition from the library menu to return to all titles. Actors with an online person page still open that page; directors without one remain static.

Actor filtering requires MovieClaw Server 0.48.0 or later. Minimum server version remains 0.31.0, as in 0.13.0. Also check sidebar navigation, window resizing, and normal playback.
betaTestNotes.zh-Hans:
0.14.1：从本地演员找到同库作品。

在本地库或 NFO 库的条目详情中，点没有在线影人页的演员，检查是否打开同一媒体库的演员作品墙，库名下应显示「演员：姓名」。从媒体库菜单移除该条件后应回到全部条目。带在线影人页的演员仍打开影人页，没有影人页的导演不可点。

演员筛选需要 MovieClaw 服务器 0.48.0 或更新版本；最低服务器要求仍为 0.31.0，与 0.13.0 相同。请一并检查侧边栏导航、窗口调整和正常播放。

0.14.1：用遥控器找到本地演员的同库作品。

在本地库或 NFO 库的条目详情中，把焦点移到没有在线影人页的演员并按遥控器，检查是否打开同一媒体库的演员作品墙，摘要应显示「演员：姓名」。从排序与筛选菜单移除演员后应回到全部条目。带在线影人页的演员仍打开影人页，没有影人页的导演不可点。

演员筛选需要 MovieClaw 服务器 0.48.0 或更新版本；最低服务器要求仍为 0.28.0，与 0.13.0 相同。请一并检查海报墙焦点、返回导航和正常播放。
betaTestNotes.en-US:
0.14.1: Browse a local actor’s work with the remote.

In a local or NFO library, open an item, focus an actor without an online person page, and select the card. Check that the same library opens with Actor: Name in the wall summary. Remove the actor from the sort and filter menu to return to all titles. Actors with an online person page still open that page; directors without one remain static.

Actor filtering requires MovieClaw Server 0.48.0 or later. Minimum server version remains 0.28.0, as in 0.13.0. Also check poster-wall focus, back navigation, and normal playback.
